thread:
Isha (Support): Escalation -> LatticeHealth private deployment onboarding blocked. Provisioning of customer-managed private nodes fails during key unwrap with a 403 from KMS. Customer is in private deployment onboarding; renewal ~6 weeks. Opened INC-10021. Need CS to own customer comms + enablement while infra triages.

Rory (CS): Thanks Isha. Can you confirm whether this is a new Private install or an upgrade? Who's the Lattice POC?

Isha (Support): New private deployment (VPC + on-prem gateway). POC is Diego (diego@latticehealth.com). Failure happens during node bootstrap when we call KMS to unwrap model access key. Error in logs: 403 Forbidden "access_denied: kms:Decrypt". Happening immediately after agent registration.

Sam (CSM): Marking P0 for CS handoff because customer cannot finish onboarding and is timeboxed. Comms plan: 1) send a short transparent note to Diego explaining current mitigation and ETA, 2) offer live screen-share to run manual key unwrap and temporary service token, 3) create renewal watch in CRM. Who can own triage?

Nina (Solutions Eng): I can triage KMS policy and bootstrap flow. Hypothesis: KMS key policy missing new principal for the bootstrap role (recent change in infra mapping). Quick mitigation: perform manual unwrap via support ops using an on-call KMS principal and provide a short-lived token for node registration. Will need infra to rotate access audit logs. ETA initial RCA 2 hours, manual workaround available in ~30-45 minutes.

Rory (CS): Isha please DM Diego the one-pager and ask for an available 30m slot for immediate screen-share. Sam, I'll tag you as primary for the manual unblock. Include clear escalation path.

Isha (Support): DM sent to Diego. Repro steps for engineers: 
```
1) run agent bootstrap: ./redwood-agent init --tenant lattice
2) agent POST to /v1/private/nodes/register -> calls kms:Decrypt with ciphertext
3) KMS responds 403 access_denied
Logs: "kms:Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-bootstrap"
```
Attached trace ids in INC-10021.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Tactical plan: 1) Confirm which principal is used in customer's env (role mapping), 2) check key policy for MissingPrincipal entry, 3) if policy is missing, perform manual unwrap using on-call principal and generate ephemeral node token (valid 1h), 4) patch key policy with correct principal and audit. I'll coordinate with infra.

Sam (CSM): I'll prepare a short email to Diego: 
"Hi Diego — were seeing KMS access_denied during node bootstrap. We can run a manual key unwrap and create ephemeral node tokens to get you past onboarding while engineering fixes the key policy. ETA for manual unblock: ~45m, RCA update in 2h, full fix within 24h. Please confirm a phone/Zoom now if youd like us to run the workaround"

InfraBot: INC-10021 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: Nina (SE), Sam (CSM) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-10021

Rory (CS): Owners recap: Nina = SE owner (triage & patch), Sam = CS owner (customer comms & manual ops), Isha = Support logs & repro. Rory = renewal watch & postmortem lead. Sam post the sent email link here when sent. Nina ping when manual token is ready.

Isha (Support): DM'ed full trace bundle and agent debug output to Nina and Infra. Diego replied to confirm a Zoom at 10:15 PT.

Nina (Solutions Eng): Manual unwrap complete; ephemeral node token issued and validated on the customer's new nodes. Pushed key-policy patch to staging key and opened PR for policy change. Will schedule prod policy change after audit sign-off. Pinging for postmortem once stable.

Sam (CSM): Sent email to Diego and joined Zoom. Provided manual unblock and documented steps in the playbook: https://redwood.playbooks/private-onboard-kms-workaround. Diego very appreciative; asked to keep renewal watch open.

Rory (CS): Filing CRM renewal watch: "Private deployment onboarding friction; manual workaround executed; SE patching key policy; renewal in 6w." Reconnect after Nina's RCA. Thanks team. :sparkles:
